desc_id: Kuda kepang untuk tari kuda lumping dibuat dari anyaman bambu, lalu dicat dan dihias kain warna-warni. Agar kesenian ini tidak hilang, anak-anak muda diajak berlatih menari kuda lumping.
desc_en: The hobby horses for the kuda lumping dance are made of woven bamboo, then painted and decorated with colourful cloth. So that this art does not disappear, young people are invited to practise the dance.
